LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.WealthPriceS: Multiplies the wealth-based portion of every service's price (each service adds a small percentage of your total colony wealth on top of its minimum cost; this scales that percentage up or down). 100% leaves service pricing at its default balance.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.GoodwillDisc: Scales how much a settlement's price discounts to you at +20/+40/+60/+80/+100 goodwill. 100% is the default balance; 0% removes goodwill's effect on price entirely.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.InvestmentCo: Scales the silver cost of investing in a settlement (default: 1% of total player wealth x the difficulty multiplier).
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.InvestmentDi: Scales the discount a fresh investment grants (default: 15% off, before decay).
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.InvestmentDe: Scales how long an investment takes to fully decay (default: about 30 in-game days).
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.DifficultyMu: Multiplies the wealth-based price surcharge when this difficulty is active. 100% applies no extra scaling beyond the wealth-based surcharge itself.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.ServiceEvent: How often paid services can trigger a bonus or complication beyond their normal outcome, relative to each service's own default rate.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.SoundtrackEn: Fade in a short ambient loop while browsing a settlement's services menu, and fade normal music back in when you close it.
